channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Arthur Henrique (PL) estará nas urnas em eleição de RR apesar de decisão de Dino
item.description: Arthur Henrique, the Liberal Party (PL) candidate for governor of Roraima, will appear on the ballot in the supplementary elections on June 21, despite a ruling by Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino declaring him ineligible due to insufficient disaffiliation period. The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) allowed his candidacy to remain 'sub judice', meaning votes cast for him will be held and only counted if he is later deemed eligible by the courts. The race also includes Frank and Barto Makuxi (PT), Soldado Sampaio and Tayla Peres (Republicanos), following the ineligibility of former governor Antonio Denarium.

item.title: Renan Calheiros vai ao STF contra senadora que o chamou de ‘homem mais corrupto do Brasil’
item.description: Senator Renan Calheiros (MDB-AL) filed a criminal complaint at the Supreme Federal Court (STF) against Senator Eudócia Caldas (PSDB-AL) for slander and defamation after she called him 'the most corrupt man in Brazil' during a Senate committee meeting and repeated the statement on her personal Instagram profile. Renan's legal team argues the remarks are not covered by parliamentary immunity, as they were made in a personal context and contain offensive, knowingly false claims based on decades-old allegations that never resulted in sanctions. The case’s rapporteur has not yet been assigned by the STF.

item.title: Trump chama Lula de ‘muito volátil, mas muito inteligente’ e diz que ‘não poderia se importar menos’
item.description: Donald Trump praised Lula as 'very intelligent' despite calling him 'very volatile,' adding that he 'couldn't care less' about him, while describing Brazil's political situation as 'a little dangerous' following Eduardo Bolsonaro's conviction. Lula responded that Trump knows little about Brazil and urged him not to interfere in Brazilian elections, stating that U.S. elections are America's problem and Brazilian elections are Brazil's problem.

item.title: Por Dentro das Eleições: entenda o que são e como funcionam as convenções partidárias
item.description: Party conventions for the 2026 Elections must be held between July 20 and August 5, as defined by TSE Resolution No. 23.609/2019, to select candidates and form coalitions. Federations hold unified conventions, respecting their statutes and electoral laws. This is the mandatory step before any candidacy can be officially registered.

item.title: PT aciona TSE contra vídeo de Flávio que associa partido a facções
item.description: The Hope Brazil Federation (PT, PV and PCdoB) filed a complaint with the TSE against Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) for an AI-generated video linking the PT to criminal factions (CV and PCC), published before the legal campaign period. The video shows Flávio and Jair Bolsonaro destroying vessels marked CV and PCC while a PT-labeled vessel is pursued. The federation demands removal within 24 hours, a fine of up to R$30,000, and prevention of similar content.

item.title: O impacto do enrosco de Jaques Wagner sobre uma possível nova indicação de Messias ao STF
item.description: The Federal Police operation in the Master Case against Senator Jaques Wagner, Lula’s government leader in the Senate, weakens the political articulation needed for a potential new nomination of Jorge Messias to the STF. While the investigation alone is not seen as disqualifying, it comes at a critical time when the Planalto must rebuild ties with Senate President Davi Alcolumbre after Messias’s April rejection. Despite pressures, Messias retains internal support, but there are divisions in the base over whether Wagner should step down to avoid political contamination.

item.title: Diálogo de Vorcaro cita Jaques Wagner como intermediário para recado a Lula, indica PF
item.description: Messages found by the Federal Police on banker Daniel Vorcaro’s phone indicate he cited Senator Jaques Wagner (PT-BA) as an intermediary to send a message to President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, leveraging the perceived closeness to the federal government. The exchanges, from July 2024, show Vorcaro sought to use this alleged connection as 'marketing' for his bank, though Wagner denied any relationship, stating he did not participate in the conversations and had no knowledge of their content. The PF also notes the material suggests proximity between Vorcaro and Bahian political figures, including publicist Guilherme Sodré, a close friend of the senator.

item.title: Fazenda avalia elevar limite do MEI para R$ 130 mil e descarta ampliar Simples Nacional
item.description: The federal government is evaluating a gradual increase in the annual revenue limit for MEI (Microempreendedor Individual) from R$81,000 to R$130,000 by 2028, with phased increases in 2027 and 2028 via a complementary law, following an agreement between Lula and Hugo Motta. The Ministry of Finance rejected expanding the Simples Nacional due to high fiscal costs and denied that the MEI increase is compensation for labor reforms like ending the 6×1 work schedule. Durigan also noted STF receptivity to a sumula requiring impact assessments for public spending or revenue-reducing bills.

item.title: “O Neymar não conheceu a esposa dele na cadeia”, diz Nikolas a Lula
item.description: Federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) rebutted President Lula's claim that Neymar Jr. was the 'world's first home office call-up', stating the player stayed home due to injury while Lula was absent because he had been convicted. Ferreira sarcastically added that 'Neymar did not meet his wife in jail', referencing Lula's conviction in Operation Car Wash.

item.title: Moraes autoriza depoimento de Bolsonaro à Polícia Civil sobre arma apreendida
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes authorized Jair Bolsonaro to testify before the Civil Police regarding the seizure of a firearm in his name, scheduled for Tuesday (23) at the former president's residence. The ruling is part of an investigation into alleged illegal possession of a weapon.

item.title: Trump ameaça o Brasil. Estaria querendo Lula eleito no primeiro turno?
item.description: The text criticizes threats made by Donald Trump against Brazil, suggests he might be trying to influence the 2026 elections to favor Lula in the first round and denounces alleged U.S. interference in Brazil's political process. It also references statements by Flávio Bolsonaro about using force against the Supreme Court and mentions the Brazilian government's offer of rare earths and Pix to Trump.

item.title: Fala de Trump sobre o Brasil é engolida pela Copa nas redes
item.description: Donald Trump's remarks labeling Brazil as 'dangerous' and 'politically difficult' at the G7 summit in France prompted reactions from Lula, Bolsonaro supporters, and the media, but were largely drowned out on social media by discussions about the World Cup. Despite generating news coverage, the statement failed to rival the engagement driven by the tournament. The full article is available only to subscribers.

item.title: MP transforma Enamed em exame de avaliação obrigatória para concluir curso de medicina
item.description: President Lula signed a provisional measure making the National Medical Education Evaluation Exam (Enamed) mandatory for medical school graduation, replacing the proposed dual-exam system (Enamed and Profimed) with a single test administered by MEC and Inep. The passing score is 60 points on a 0–100 scale, with semi-annual administration and no limit on retakes. The measure centralizes medical evaluation under the MEC, opposing Senate and House bills that would assign exam development to the Federal Medical Council (CFM).

item.title: Clica e Confirma: programa destaca eleições suplementares e preparativos para as Eleições 2026
item.description: The Clica e Confirma program highlights the supplementary elections taking place this Sunday in five municipalities and Roraima, where voters will elect new mayors, deputy mayors, and the state governor. It also covers the agreement between the TSE and 27 political parties to promote safe and fair elections in 2026, along with a logistical assessment to support hard-to-reach areas with assistance from the Armed Forces. The segment underscores the Electoral Justice's commitment to transparency and readiness for the 2026 general elections.

item.title: Moraes autoriza Polícia Civil a ouvir Bolsonaro na prisão domiciliar sobre arma apreendida em blitz
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes authorized the Federal District Civil Police to take the in-person testimony of former President Jair Bolsonaro at his house arrest regarding a firearm seized during a police checkpoint. The Glock 9mm pistol, registered in Bolsonaro's name, was in the vehicle of a GSI military officer assigned to his security detail but was confiscated because the Firearms Registration Certificate (CRAF) was not present in the car. The testimony is scheduled for Tuesday (23) after an attempted videoconference deposition failed due to security escort restrictions.

item.title: Trump chama Lula de 'muito volátil' e diz que 'não poderia se importar menos' com o brasileiro
item.description: Donald Trump described Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva as 'very volatile' and said he 'could not care less' about him in an Axios interview. He mentioned having spoken with Lula at the G7 in France, where he called Brazil a 'politically difficult' country, and praised the intelligence of global leaders such as China's Xi Jinping.

item.title: Governo torna Enamed obrigatório para estudantes de medicina
item.description: The federal government issued a provisional measure making the National Medical Education Evaluation Exam (Enamed) mandatory for sixth-year medical students, requiring a minimum score to obtain the right to practice medicine. Signed by President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, the measure gives the exam legal force as a tool for evaluating medical training in Brazil.

item.title: Em MG, Lula agita militância e ignora Jaques Wagner em discursos
item.description: President Lula visited Minas Gerais to attend health-related events, announcing R$ 89.3 million in investments for the Luxemburgo Hospital and inaugurating the Regional University Hospital in Divinópolis. He avoided commenting on the Federal Police investigation targeting Senator Jaques Wagner, the government leader in the Senate, responding only with a thumbs-up gesture when questioned by journalists. Despite energizing the base and making pre-campaign remarks, Lula did not address the PT’s lack of a gubernatorial candidate in Minas Gerais, a growing concern within the party.

item.title: “Quem dera se a Janja fosse primeira-dama home office”, diz Zema
item.description: Romeu Zema, former governor of Minas Gerais and pre-candidate for President from the Novo party, criticized President Lula's comment that Neymar Jr. is the 'world's first home office call-up', sarcastically wishing that Janja could be a 'home office first lady'. The remark came in response to Lula's analogy between Neymar's remote recovery during injury and remote work in public administration.

item.title: Eduardo Gomes lidera disputa ao Senado no TO, diz pesquisa
item.description: Eduardo Gomes (PL) leads the Senate race in Tocantins with 25% of voter intentions, followed by Alexandre Guimarães (MDB) at 15%, according to a Real Time Big Data poll released on June 19, 2026. The survey interviewed 1,600 voters between June 17–18, has a 2-point margin of error and 95% confidence level, and is registered with the TSE under number TO-05379/2026.

item.title: Trump diz que não se importa com Lula: ‘Pessoa muito volátil’
item.description: Donald Trump said he does not care about Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, describing him as 'very volatile' and stating he does not think about him, neither positively nor negatively. The remarks mark a sharp contrast from their May meeting at the White House, where Trump praised Lula as 'very dynamic' and called the encounter productive. Lula had previously urged Trump not to interfere in Brazil’s elections, following the conviction of Eduardo Bolsonaro for attempting to interfere in his father Jair Bolsonaro’s trial.

item.title: Trump diz que Lula é ‘muito volátil’ e ‘não poderia se importar menos’ com brasileiro
item.description: Donald Trump described Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva as 'very volatile' and said he 'couldn’t care less' about him in an Axios interview. The remarks follow a public exchange at the G7, where Lula criticized U.S. interference in Brazil’s elections. Trump also incorrectly claimed Eduardo Bolsonaro had been jailed, confusing the legal outcome.

item.title: Zico aponta Endrick como trunfo e diz que está fácil marcar o Brasil
item.description: Zico praised young striker Endrick as a trump card for the Brazilian national team in the 2026 World Cup, highlighting his personality, effort, and ability to bother defenders, even after starting on the bench against Morocco. He criticized the team's lack of initiative and on-field dialogue, saying it was 'easy to mark Brazil,' and noted that while Neymar remains talented, he has lost focus at times in his career due to injuries and distractions.

item.title: MP de Lula exige nota mínima no Enamed para formados poderem atuar como médicos
item.description: President Lula signed a provisional measure making the Enamed exam a mandatory requirement for medical professional registration, effective for new students starting in 2026 and as a mandatory graduation assessment for current enrollees. The exam will be administered semiannually by Inep, with individual scores contributing to a course-level Conceito Enade (1 to 5), where low scores (1 or 2) may trigger regulatory actions such as reduced enrollment or course deactivation.

item.title: Estudantes terão de obter nota mínima em exame para exercer medicina
item.description: President Lula signed a provisional measure establishing a mandatory minimum score on the National Medical Education Evaluation Exam (Enamed) for medical students to obtain professional licensure. Students will take the exam twice: at the end of the 4th year and upon course completion. Those who fail to meet the minimum score in the final stage may still graduate but must retake the exam to practice medicine and register with Regional Medical Councils (CRMs). The measure also makes Enamed semiannual and records the score in the academic transcript.

item.title: Trump classifica Lula como ‘muito volátil’, mas diz não se importar com o brasileiro
item.description: Donald Trump described Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva as 'very volatile' but said he does not care about him, stating he 'doesn't think about him' and 'couldn't care less'. The remarks came two days after Lula told Trump not to interfere in Brazilian elections. Despite the criticism, Trump acknowledged volatility can be part of leadership and that all leaders must be intelligent to reach their position.

item.title: César Menotti e Fabiano abrem 2º Arraiá do Paço de São Bernardo do Campo
item.description: The 2nd Arraiá do Paço in São Bernardo do Campo kicks off this Friday (June 19) with a free show by César Menotti & Fabiano, alongside the broadcast of Brazil's second match in the 2026 World Cup. Entry is by donation of 1kg of non-perishable food, and the festival runs through June 28, featuring performances by Rastapé, Péricles and other traditional June festivities. The event is organized via a public-private partnership at no cost to the municipality.

item.title: Sistema de Candidaturas traz novidades para as Eleições Gerais de 2026
item.description: The TSE unveiled a new web-based version of CANDex, the candidacy system for the 2026 General Elections, enabling remote access without local installation or updates. The tool now integrates with the electoral registry, allowing pre-filling of candidates' personal data if their names appear in party convention minutes, with parties responsible for validating the imported information.

item.title: PT aciona TSE contra Flávio por vídeo de IA com paródia de Top Gun
item.description: The Hope Brazil Federation (PT, PCdoB, PV) filed a complaint with the TSE against Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) over an AI-generated deepfake video parodying Top Gun, which falsely links the PT to organized crime and constitutes illegal negative pre-campaign propaganda. The video, released after his meeting with Donald Trump and following the U.S. designation of PCC and CV as terrorist organizations, depicts Bolsonaro and his father attacking boats labeled with criminal faction symbols, while the PT-branded vessel retreats.

item.title: Jaques Wagner, alvo da PF, é o único petista que ainda consegue dizer ‘não’ a Lula; leia bastidores
item.description: Jaques Wagner, senator and government leader in the Senate, is under PF investigation in Operation Compliance Zero linked to Banco Master, threatening his role as one of the few PT members able to say 'no' to Lula. Despite pressure to resign, he resists, arguing it would be an admission of guilt, while the government faces political wear and loses a historic ally in congressional articulation. The crisis unfolds at a sensitive moment, as Lula seeks to regain popularity and now loses a shield against attacks from opponents like Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Flávio diz não pretender atacar pisos da saúde e educação, vinculação do mínimo e Previdência
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a pre-candidate for president, stated he does not intend to attack the constitutional floors for health and education, maintain the linkage of the minimum wage to inflation, or pursue a pension reform. The remarks were made in an interview with SBT News, responding to questions about his intentions regarding these sensitive social policy issues in Brazil.

item.title: Estudante de Medicina precisará de nota mínima no Enamed para exercer profissão
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva signed a provisional measure making the National Exam for Medical Education Assessment (Enamed) mandatory and establishing a minimum score for medical students to practice medicine in Brazil. The measure aims to ensure the quality of medical education and standardize the evaluation of medical degree programs nationwide.

item.title: “Não poderia me importar menos”, diz Trump sobre Lula
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump said in an Axios interview that he 'could not care less' about Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, describing him as 'very volatile'. Trump mentioned he had observed Brazil and had some acquaintance with Lula, but expressed no interest or sympathy toward the PT leader.

item.title: Moraes vota contra, mas STF tem maioria para manter perdão a partidos por descumprimento de cotas
item.description: The Supreme Federal Court upheld, by a 6-4 vote, the constitutionality of the amendment that pardoned political parties for failing to meet gender and racial quotas, despite Alexandre de Moraes voting against it. The rule requires parties to redirect unspent funds to Black candidacies in the next four elections starting in 2026, rather than pay fines. The virtual plenary judgment remains open until April 26, allowing justices to change their votes or request a physical hearing.

item.title: Tribunal absolve Pedro Rousseff por post sobre Dallagnol
item.description: The TRE-PR acquitted Pedro Rousseff and Gleisi Hoffmann of fines for statements regarding Deltan Dallagnol's ineligibility, ruling that such public assertions—when tied to prior judicial decisions and part of public interest debate—do not automatically constitute electoral disinformation or negative pre-campaign propaganda. The ruling aligns with STF precedents and marks a shift in the Paraná electoral court’s stance, annulling fines, reversing content removal orders, and lifting bans on future publications. Judges emphasized that the decision does not determine Dallagnol’s eligibility, which must be assessed in a candidacy registration process.

item.title: Trump diz que Lula é uma pessoa muito volátil e que não se importa com ele
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump described Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva as a 'very volatile' person and said he does not care about him. The comment was made in an interview with Axios, highlighting strains in the U.S.-Brazil bilateral relationship.

item.title: PT vai o TSE para tirar vídeo que Flávio Bolsonaro associa partido ao PCC
item.description: The Brazil of Hope Federation (PT, PV, and PCdoB) filed a complaint with the TSE against Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) over an AI-generated video linking the PT to the PCC and CV criminal factions. The federation claims the video is disinformation and seeks its removal and potential sanctions for abuse of political power.

item.title: Crusoé: Janaina reclama de interferência do governo Lula na PF
item.description: São Paulo councilwoman Janaina Paschoal (PP-SP) criticized the Lula government for alleged interference in the Federal Police's investigation of the Master case, after the operation reached Senator Jaques Wagner (PT-BA), the government leader in the Senate. She claimed the Ministry of Justice ordered the return of Federal Police-delegated officers, which she described as an attempt to obstruct the investigation. The post followed a Estadão report on the matter.

item.title: Lula assina MP que vincula exercício da medicina à aprovação no Enamed
item.description: President Lula signed a provisional measure making approval in the Enamed exam mandatory for medical practice, to be taken in the 4th and 6th years of medical school. The initiative aims to align medical training with SUS needs and integrate assessment with processes like Revalida and medical residency selection.

item.title: Professora Dorinha lidera disputa ao governo do TO, diz pesquisa
item.description: Professor Dorinha (União Brasil) leads the race for governor of Tocantins in all scenarios tested by Real Time Big Data, with 33% in the first round and up to 35% in scenarios excluding Katia Abreu. Vicentinho Júnior (PSDB) and Laurez Moreira (PSD) follow in second and third place, respectively, technically tied within the margin of error. In the second round, Dorinha defeats both opponents with comfortable margins (48% over Laurez and 43% over Vicentinho).

item.title: Lula assina MP e Enamed passa a ser obrigatório para médicos
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva signed a Provisional Measure making the National Medical Education Assessment Exam (Enamed) mandatory for medical licensure in Brazil. The exam will be administered semestrally by MEC/Inep, starting in the eighth semester of medical school, replacing the theoretical phase of Revalida and serving as a prerequisite for Enare. The passing score is 60 points, with the first Enamed 2027 edition scheduled for May 2026.

item.title: Lula é uma pessoa 'muito volátil', diz Trump
item.description: Donald Trump described Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva as 'very volatile' in an Axios interview, stating he does not think about Lula and 'could not care less' about him. The remarks come amid growing U.S.-Brazil tensions, including new U.S. tariffs and the designation of PCC and CV as terrorist groups.

item.title: Exército relembra “Jogo da Paz” entre as seleções de Brasil e Haiti
item.description: The Brazilian Army recalled the 'Peace Game', a friendly match between Brazil and Haiti held in 2004, in an Instagram post made on Friday, June 19, 2026, on the eve of the teams' reunion at the World Cup. The initiative highlighted Brazil's role in the MINUSTAH mission, which it led, and emphasized the friendship bonds built between the nations through sport and military cooperation. The post included a video of the event and stressed that, although they are opponents on the field, the peoples are 'brothers for eternity'.

item.title: Dizer que Deltan está inelegível não é propaganda antecipada, decide o TRE-PR
item.description: The Paraná Regional Electoral Court (TRE-PR) annulled fines and content removal orders against Belo Horizonte councilman Pedro Rousseff (PT) and federal deputy Gleisi Hoffmann (PT-PR) after ruling that stating Deltan Dallagnol is ineligible does not constitute premature election propaganda or fake news. The court aligned its stance with the Supreme Federal Court (STF), holding that discussing a pre-candidate’s legal situation is protected free speech in a democratic environment. The original penalties had been imposed over 2023 social media posts following the TSE’s cancellation of Dallagnol’s candidacy registration.

item.title: Campanha de Lula pede remoção de vídeo feito com IA em que Flávio metralha PCC e CV e mira no PT
item.description: Lula’s pre-campaign filed a complaint with the TSE requesting the removal of an AI-generated video posted by Flávio Bolsonaro on social media, in which he and Jair Bolsonaro are depicted as special forces soldiers firing from an aircraft at boats labeled 'PCC' and 'CV'. The Lula campaign labeled the video as disinformation and symbolic aggression against the Workers’ Party (PT).

item.title: Trump chama Lula de "volátil" e diz não se importar com o brasileiro
item.description: Donald Trump described Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva as 'very volatile' and said he does not care about the Brazilian president, while acknowledging his intelligence to attain power. The remarks were made in an Axios interview and followed Trump’s characterization of Brazil as 'politically difficult' at the G7 summit, prompting an immediate rebuttal from Lula, who stated Trump 'does not know Brazil'.

item.title: Os dois motivos que mais irritaram Lula sobre o envolvimento de Jaques Wagner no caso Master
item.description: Lula’s aides reported that the president was very irritated by the involvement of Senate government leader Jaques Wagner in the Banco Master scandal. His irritation stemmed from two main concerns: the perception that Wagner acted for personal or allied benefit, undermining the government’s image of transparency, and the fear that the scandal could cause political damage and be exploited by the opposition to attack the PT administration.

item.title: “Se a PF puxar o fio, o PT acaba”, diz Flávio
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) rebutted Senator Jaques Wagner's (PT-BA) accusation that he spread 'fake news' regarding the Banco Master scandal originating in Bahia's PT. In a video, Flávio claimed that if the Federal Police pulls the thread, the PT will collapse, linking Wagner to alleged irregularities in the scandal.

item.title: Onça vidente na Copa de 2022 prevê jogo duro do Brasil contra o Haiti
item.description: The jaguar at Gramadozoo, which correctly predicted all of Brazil's results in the 2022 World Cup, forecast a tough match for Brazil against Haiti in the 2026 World Cup by selecting the box with the opponent's flag during an environmental enrichment activity. This followed the same pattern as the first match against Morocco, which ended in a draw. The zoo emphasizes there is no scientific basis for the prediction, describing it as natural exploratory behavior.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz que há corrupção de ‘amigos de Lula junto a Vorcaro’: ‘Votos voltarão para mim’
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro claims that his declining poll numbers will reverse, arguing that corruption involving Lula's allies and banker Daniel Vorcaro in the Banco Master scandal has been proven. He denies any wrongdoing in his relationship with Vorcaro, stating it was purely about private investments, and considers the case against Jaques Wagner more serious than the allegations about financing Jair Bolsonaro's biopic. He also suggested that Lula's son, 'Lulinha', may have received retirees' funds in European accounts, a claim denied by his defense.
